name: Earnings-response reversal
hypothesis: Fade only after the reversal is observable and the release has been correctly parsed.
spec: Setup: A release causes a large reaction that fails a predefined acceptance test. Entry: Fade only after the reversal is observable and the release has been correctly parsed. Exit: Stop beyond the reaction extreme; exit at partial retracement or time. Parameters to pre-register: reaction_threshold, failure_window, reversal_trigger, target.
blocked_reason: needs a licensed event feed (earnings surprises, consensus, filings, auction or halt data) with receipt times
